subject: Stakeholder availability & priority matrix for 30m briefing
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder availability & priority matrix for 30m briefing

Hi Sofia —

Great conversation earlier — thanks for walking us through Novapulse's ingestion and moderation pain points. Per our call, next step is a focused 30-minute product intro (high-level demo + short Q&A) with your stakeholders so we can align on an evaluation path.

Two quick asks so we can lock the right format:
- Who from your side should attend (technical owner / data lead / procurement)?
- Which of the priority areas below should we emphasize (pick 1-2):
  * Latency & throughput for ingestion pipelines
  * On-prem / VPC deployment needs
  * Cost optimization (batching/quantization)

I've attached a 1-page briefing outline that maps expected agenda and prep asks. Once you confirm attendees and priorities I'll propose 2–3 concrete slots that align to your timezone.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
Book time: https://cal.redwood.ai/mateo

Attachments: redwood-brief-outline.pdf (PDF, 110 KB)

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novapulse.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder availability & priority matrix for 30m briefing

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the recap and for the outline — that looks useful. For the session we'd like the following people on the invite:
- Carla Mendez (CTO)
- Anil Kapoor (Data Engineering lead)
- Myself (Sofia, Head of Product)

Top priorities are: latency/throughput and deployment model (we need to validate both hosted and VPC options).

A couple of slots that work for the group next week:
- Tue 6 Apr, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 7 Apr, 14:30–15:00 PT

If neither works we can open to other times — please advise if either slot works on your side and who from Redwood will lead the demo + technical deep dive if questions get detailed.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Product, Novapulse
sofia.ramos@novapulse.com | +1 (206) 555-2090

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novapulse.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder availability & priority matrix for 30m briefing

Thanks Sofia — that's helpful. We've confirmed the right lineup on our side: I'll do the customer-facing intro and Marissa (solutions engineering) will take the technical portion and handle any architecture questions. Karthik (in cc) will join for any licensing/SLA questions if those come up.

Based on the priorities you listed (latency & deployment model) and the attendee list, here are three slots that fit our calendars (all PT):
1) Tue 6 Apr, 10:00–10:30 PT — matches one of your options (preferred for short exec intro + demo)
2) Wed 7 Apr, 09:00–09:30 PT — earlier slot if you want to move the Data Eng team before their standups
3) Thu 8 Apr, 13:00–13:30 PT — slightly longer window if we need a quick architecture diagram walkthrough

Proposed agenda (30 min):
- 0:00–0:05 — quick intros & outcomes
- 0:05–0:20 — focused product walkthrough (ingestion -> serving -> ops) emphasizing latency profiles and deployment modes
- 0:20–0:28 — technical Q&A (KV cache, batching, certs/integration)
- 0:28–0:30 — immediate next steps / pilot options

Prep asks (one-liners):
- If Anil can share a short note on current ingest TPS and target latency that would help us tailor the demo
- If Carla has any regulatory constraints (e.g., data residency) please flag up-front

I've reattached the 1-pager and a short priority matrix we use to tailor demos. If you confirm attendees + pick a slot I'll send a calendar invite and an optional short pre-read for the EngOps team.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148

Attachments: redwood-brief-outline.pdf

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@novapulse.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carla Mendez <carla.mendez@novapulse.com>, Anil Kapoor <anil.kapoor@novapulse.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder availability & priority matrix for 30m briefing

Hi Mateo / team —

Thanks for the options and the agenda — Tue 6 Apr, 10:00–10:30 PT works for us. I'll send a calendar invite from my side with Carla and Anil included.

Quick answers to prep asks:
- Anil: current ingest is ~120 TPS, target is <50ms for median latency on inference paths (we're mostly concerned about tail latencies)
- Carla: No extra residency constraints right now but we'll confirm if the procurement team surfaces anything around certs

Please send the invite + pre-read when you have it. Look forward to the session.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Product, Novapulse
